title: (No AI) Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
dc:creator: Connie Loizos
content: Elon Musk says a secretive new SpaceX foundry will let him cast his own turbine blades and get gas power online 18 months faster than anyone else — but it's a bet on a fuel source that's already triggering lawsuits and health studies everywhere his (and others') turbines have gone in.

title: (No AI) Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![Illustration of hands holding instruments to destroy a Flock camera](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/268713_Americans_seem_to_agree_that_destroy_Flock_cameras_is_good_CVirginia.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

As backlash grows over Flock's AI surveillance cameras, Texas Governor Greg Abbott has [frozen state spending](https://www.texastribune.org/2026/08/28/texas-greg-abbott-flock-cameras-order-state-money/) on them. The move came just ahead of the publication of a [_Texas Tribune_ investigation](https://www.texastribune.org/2026/08/28/texas-flock-cameras-auto-insurance-fee-mvcpa-grants/) that revealed the state spent over $30 million on Flock cameras. That money was primarily raised by tacking a $1 fee onto insurance policies, allegedly to help fight catalytic converter theft.

Flock cameras have increasingly drawn ire from [across the political spectrum](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/08/29/flock-cameras-stir-bipartisan-fury-gov-greg-abbott-blocks-them-texas/) as they've become the subject of privacy concerns. There have been multiple incidents of officers being placed on leave or [criminally charged](https://www.404media.co/cops-keep-getting-arrested-for-using-flock-to-stalk-people/) for misusing Flock systems, including at …

title: (No AI) Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![Anthropic logo on an orange and grey background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/01/STK269_ANTHROPIC_2_A.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell have [filed suit against Anthropic](https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/now-sony-music-publishing-and-warner-chappell-sue-anthropic-in-multi-billion-dollar-lawsuit-one-of-the-largest-and-most-blatant-ongoing-thefts-of-intellectual-property-in-history/) in the US District Court for the Northern District of California seeking damages for "tens of thousands" copyrighted works. The companies are asking for up to $150,000 per work, plus up to $25,000 for each instance when identifiable copyright data was stripped. In total, the damages could amount to several billion dollars if a court finds in Sony and Warner's favor and awards the maximum amount.

This is just the latest high-profile suit against Anthropic, which recently settled a suit [brought by the publishing industry](https://www.theverge.com/2024/8/20/24224450/anthropic-copyright-lawsuit-pirated-books-ai) for [$1.5 billion](https://www.theverge.com/anthropic/773087/anthropic-to-pay-1-5-billion-to-authors-in-landmark-ai-settlement). It's also [faced](https://www.theverge.com/2025/1/3/24334866/anthropic-claude-music-publishers-lyric-copyright-lawsuit-deal) [multiple](https://www.theverge.com/2023/10/19/23924100/universal-music-sue-anthropic-lyrics-copyright-katy-perry) [la …](https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/umg-concord-and-abkco-sue-anthropic-for-3bn-in-what-could-be-single-largest-non-class-action-copyright-case-in-us-history/)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/986438/sony-music-warner-chappell-anthropic-lawsuit-copyright)
